native_tray_capture_window_title: Title of the capture overlay and pinned screenshot windows, read by window switchers and screen readers.
native_tray_dock_hide: Tray menu item and agent dock right-click item that hide the agent dock. Without a shortcut the item is just this text.
native_tray_dock_hide_key: Right-click item of the agent dock that hides it, with the shortcut that does the same ({key}, already formatted for the OS). Two spaces separate the text from the shortcut on purpose.
native_tray_dock_show: Tray menu item that shows the agent dock (the small always-on-top pill that sends text to agents) when it is hidden.
native_tray_dock_window_title: Title of the agent dock window, read by window switchers and screen readers.
native_tray_open: Tray menu item and agent dock right-click item that bring the main window forward.
native_tray_quit: Tray menu item that quits Atlas. Windows tray menus say Exit, macOS and Linux say Quit.
native_tray_toggle: Tray menu item (Linux) that hides the main window when it is showing and shows it when it is not.
